question: On s022814's text window, do fields built from that surface's own lines about 2 mm and 4.5 mm apart, joined by the sheet-direction fill, read rows for both raters, on the same page as fullhop_s022814?
window: the same s022814 window and page as fullhop_s022814 (11 pictures, common frame)

arms.O2: line_spacing primary: 10 constant-height lines cut from s022814 itself, 2.02 mm apart, joined by the frozen sheet-direction fill (12 fill rows per gap), depth picked by the window's own labels (best of 7)
arms.O45: line_spacing secondary: the same builder with 5 lines 4.54 mm apart (24 fill rows per gap), own label-picked depth

control.ctrl814: readable control: the organizers' undamaged s022814 surface over its labelled text window, fixed offset +1 layer (~2.4 um)

guards.L55_814: guard: top 45 % hopped a full sheet, nested (contains every L70_814 hop plus 15 % more), +1 layer

validity.calib: calibration: a known-rows ink map of another public fragment's known text (not this window), a picture both raters had rated before
validity.calib_blank: the calibration map in the wrong layer order (wrong-order blank)

no_line_drawn: an oracle check of line spacing: the lines are the organizers' surface's own constant-height curves (median 33 um from it by construction); nobody traced a line in the scan

rule.F3_valid_rater: every fullhop_s022814, calibration and O picture answered; calibration rows; the calibration blank, ctrl814 blank and L70_814 blank each not rows. d = the valid raters who call ctrl814 rows

F4_per_arm.X-READS: both raters in d call X rows, AND at least one of them calls H50_814 or L55_814 not rows
F4_per_arm.X-FAILS: at least one rater in d calls X not rows (decides whatever the guards say); labels X-NO if both, X-SPLIT if one of two, 'X-FAILS (one valid rater)' if d has one rater
F4_per_arm.X-LENIENT: both rows, but no 814 guard called not rows -> undecided
F4_per_arm.X-VOID: d is empty; with one rater in d, that rater's rows is a one-rater lead (undecided)

rule.wording_O2_reads: fields from perfect lines 2.02 mm apart + sheet-direction fill read rows for two blind raters on s022814's window; forecast floor at the measured fibre-tool pace 8.5-10.8 min/cm2 (starts given, perfect lines, depth chosen by this window's own labels, one window). Never 'measured minutes per readable cm2'

scope: O2 is a sparse resampling of the organizers' own surface with a label-picked depth; rated on the same page and sitting as fullhop_s022814 by raters who had seen this window before (depth_s022814)
